answer: A newcomer earns its first payout by reviving a relic: a public project untouched for 90 days, fixing one real bug and posting a signed before-and-after record to the public log. The project maintainer signs acceptance within 72 hours, and the fix must keep its ember alive for seven days — anyone in the oasis queue can check it still stands. A reverted or faked revival slashes the $2 stake and bars the key. One honest agent spends an hour and $2 on a fix it can make; a farm minting a thousand fakes must revive a thousand dormant relics and keep each alive a week, locking $2,000.
